page.layout: Top: running head at the top of the page, with printed page number 330 at the left. Below it, a centred title block "BREVIARIUM LIBRI QUARTI." Below that, one diagram (synopsis with braces) across the page. The label "In Acie quattuor dicta:" stands at the left beside the main brace. Bottom left: one catchword. No margin notes.

l.i: Hastatos. qui per manipulos dispositi primi, cum intervallis.
Velites sparsi in manipulos, in lateribus, in fronte.
Equites, ad latera, aut interdum in viis & à tergo.
Hæc circa frontem, in quoque Genere. Unde Antesignani & Postsignani.
Ex his Tribuni, Primopili & Imperator, circa medium, circaque Aquilas: Centuriones in fronte, ad suos quosque manipulos.
De ipsis Signis & formâ, in occasione additum.
Quadrata plurimùm: eáque duplex, aut triplex.
Aliter etiam duplex aut multiplex, cum Subsidijs.
Variatur Schematismis, Cuneo, Globo, Forcipe, Turribus, Serrâ.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page (running lines in the upper and middle area, and the word fragments below the diagram) is left out. The catchword "BREVI-" stands at the lower left, not at the right as usual; it is kept because it is clearly printed. Doubtful readings: "Schematismis" (the printed form is worn; the first letters of the word are doubtful, so the spelling may differ). "Acie, ut" (the printed word after ADIUNCTA is partly worn). "Signumpugna." appears printed without a space; kept as printed. "in occasione additum." is printed as such; kept as printed. The title word "LIBRI QUARTI" is printed as a word, so caput="4" is taken from it.
